channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Australian Dollar: Gradual grind lower toward 0.6975 – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann maintain a negative stance on AUD/USD after the pair closed below 0.7000, though downside momentum is still described as modest. Intraday, they look for further slippage but doubts a clean break of 0.6975.

item.title: WTI Price Forecast: 20-day EMA remains key hurdle
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI), futures on NYMEX, trade almost 3% lower to near $87.60 during the European trading session on Thursday.

item.title: European Central Bank: Summer hikes seen as insurance – ING
item.description: ING’s Carsten Brzeski argues that the European Central Bank is being guided by its 2022 inflation experience rather than current data, with headline Eurozone inflation still moderate and survey-based expectations easing.

item.title: Euro treads water near two-month lows ahead of the ECB decision
item.description: The Euro (EUR) has given away previous gains against the US Dollar (USD) on Thursday and is trading at 1.1535 at the time of writing, practically unchanged in daily charts with the two-month lows, near 1.1500, at hand.

item.title: European Central Bank set to increase interest rates as inflation drifts away from target
item.description: The European Central Bank (ECB) is set to announce its monetary policy decision at 12:15 GMT following its June meeting.

item.title: Canadian Dollar: Seen converging to 1.38 against US Dollar – TD Securities
item.description: The Global Strategy Team at TD Securities reports that the Bank of Canada left rates unchanged at 2.25% and maintained a balanced tone. They expect the Bank to hold policy through 2026, with the next hike projected for early 2027.

item.title: Canadian Dollar edges lower as safe-haven demand, policy divergence underpin US Dollar
item.description: USD/CAD advances toward 1.3975 on Thursday at the time of writing, up 0.23% on the day, with the US Dollar (USD) benefiting from renewed safe-haven demand amid persistent tensions in the Middle East.

item.title: US Dollar: Firm tone with sticky inflation – BBH
item.description: Brown Brothers Harriman’s (BBH) Elias Haddad notes the US Dollar (USD) is firm as United States (US) data show stalled disinflation and sticky inflation measures drifting away from the Federal Reserve’s (Fed) 2% target.

item.title: Euro: Limited upside against US Dollar on fully priced ECB – ING
item.description: ING’s Chris Turner argues that with a 25bp ECB hike and further tightening already priced, the Euro faces a high bar for gains. Markets discount about 75bp of tightening through early next year.

item.title: Indian Rupee slumps amid concerns over sustainability of US-Iran ceasefire
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) tumbles at open against the US Dollar (USD) on Thursday, with the USD/INR pair rising to near 95.75. The pair gains as a sharp recovery in oil prices due to fears surrounding the collapse of the ceasefire between the United States (US) and Iran has weakened the Indian Rupee.

item.title: British Pound trades with caution ahead of UK monthly GDP data
item.description: The British Pound (GBP) trades cautiously against its major currency peers during the European trading session on Thursday, down 0.1% to near 1.3350 against the US Dollar (USD).

item.title: Gold Price Forecast: XAU/USD attempts to bounce up from the $4,000 psychological area
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) trades with minor gains on Thursday but remains struggling below $4,100, amid geopolitical uncertainty and rising bets on Federal Reserve (Fed) rate hikes.

item.title: Canadian Dollar: BoC caution limits gains against US Dollar – Commerzbank
item.description: Michael Pfister at Commerzbank notes the Bank of Canada (BoC) kept rates at 2.25% and sees little impetus for near-term tightening given easing core inflation and a weak real economy. Market pricing now reflects only one hike by December.

item.title: Australian Dollar remains depressed near two-month lows in risk-off markets
item.description: The Australian Dollar (AUD) has given away previous gains and is trading lower for the third consecutive day against a stronger US Dollar (USD) on Thursday.

item.title: US Dollar: Uptrend seen intact into FOMC – TD Securities
item.description: TD Securities strategists note that a softer core United Kingdom (UK) Consumer Price Index (CPI) print triggered initial US Dollar (USD) weakness, but they still expect the broad USD uptrend to remain supported into next week’s Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meeting.

item.title: Bank of Canada: Policy hold as recession concerns linger – Rabobank
item.description: Rabobank’s Molly Schwartz and Christian Lawrence review the latest Bank of Canada (BoC) decision, noting policymakers kept the overnight rate at 2.25% in June. They highlight ongoing risks from high energy prices and prolonged inflation, alongside a technical recession.

item.title: Euro: Downside risk against US Dollar as ECB hikes – BBH
item.description: Brown Brothers Harriman’s (BBH) Elias Haddad highlights EUR/USD trading defensively near 1.1530 ahead of an expected 25 bps European Central Bank (ECB) rate hike to 2.25% and updated projections likely downgrading growth.

item.title: Euro trades flat vs Yen as ECB guidance focus, intervention fears cap gains
item.description: EUR/JPY trades around 185.20 on Thursday at the time of writing, as market participants remain cautious ahead of the European Central Bank (ECB) monetary policy decision.

item.title: Silver price today: Silver rises, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Silver prices (XAG/USD) rose on Thursday, according to FXStreet data. Silver trades at $64.05 per troy ounce, up 1.05% from the $63.39 it cost on Wednesday.

item.title: Turkish Lira: Hawkish CBRT tone but lira risks ahead – ING
item.description: ING’s Frantisek Taborsky expects the Central Bank of Turkey (CBRT) to keep its policy rate at 37%, maintaining a tight stance and policy flexibility.

item.title: European Central Bank: Focus shifts to forward guidance – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Erik Liem expects the European Central Bank (ECB) to deliver a fully priced 25bp hike, leaving markets focused on guidance for the path of rates beyond summer.

item.title: United States Dollar Index bounces back amid US-Iran ceasefire uncertainty
item.description: The US Dollar (USD) claws back its slight early losses and edges higher during the European trading session amid intensifying fears that the ceasefire between the United States (US) and Iran, announced on April 8, could collapse due to the exchange of attacks in the last few days.

item.title: Swiss Franc: Market pricing challenges SNB stance – BNY
item.description: BNY’s Geoff Yu argues that Swiss Franc (CHF) positioning looks stretched as investors bet on policy tightening that the Swiss National Bank (SNB) is unlikely to deliver.

item.title: WTI declines to near $87.50 as US, Iran talks remain intact
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) oil price pares its recent gains from the previous day, trading around $87.60 per barrel during the European hours on Thursday.

item.title: USD/CAD Price Forecast: Rallies to 1.3970, fresh high since November 2025 on Oil slump
item.description: The USD/CAD pair attracts fresh buyers following an intraday dip to the 1.3930 area on Thursday and builds on the overnight bounce from the weekly low.

item.title: Euro: Testing support against US Dollar with ECB risk – Societe Generale
item.description: Societe Generale strategists highlight that EUR/USD remains under pressure after slipping below its 200-day moving average in May, with spot trading near a two‑month low.

item.title: Silver Price Forecasts: XAG/USD picks up above $64.00 with bears still in control
item.description: Silver (XAG/USD) appreciates on Thursday, reaching session highs at $64.50 at the time of writing, after hitting two-and-a-half-month lows at $61.50 earlier on the day. News about ongoing negotiations between the US and Iran has soothed markets, providing some support to the ailing white metal.

item.title: Canadian Dollar: BoC keeps options open on energy and trade – Deutsche Bank
item.description: Deutsche Bank highlights that the Bank of Canada left its policy rate unchanged at 2.25% but stressed flexibility. Governor Macklem indicated that sustained higher energy prices could require consecutive rate hikes, while potential US trade restrictions might instead justify rate cuts.

item.title: Gold sticks to modest recovery gains near $4,100; looks to US PPI for fresh impetus
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) trades around the $4,100 mark during the first half of the European session and is looking to build on a modest intraday recovery from its lowest level since November 2025, touched earlier this Thursday.

item.title: USD/CHF Price Forecast: Could test 0.8000 barrier near ascending channel top
item.description: USD/CHF halts its four-day winning streak, trading around 0.7990 during the European hours on Thursday. The technical analysis of the daily chart indicates the pair is moving upwards within the ascending channel pattern, signaling a persistent bullish bias.
